Wherefore he fearing that he might be put to death had sent to request Peter to come immediately if he wished to meet him alive and to appear at the proper time to the city when it was at the height of his longing for him. Peter hearing this called the multitude together to deliberate and appointed one of his attendants bishop and having remained three days in Leodosa baptizing and healing he hastened to the neighboring city of Antioch. Amen.

**[33:26]** So that is the end of the sermons of Peter and so next time we will be picking it up in the uh revelation. Thank you for listening. Shalom.
